findings.title: Concurrent builds can replace or conflict on the same index
findings.body: Removing the build-wide lock allows two callers building the same namespaced resource to create indexes concurrently. `getOrCreateIndex` can be reached concurrently before either build is cached; for file-backed indexes both builds target the same Bleve directory, while for memory indexes the later assignment replaces the earlier index. Callers may then write to an index that is no longer the cached one, so updates can be lost or the build can fail.
